findings.statement: Individual / sole proprietor; no entity registration expected. The OCCC Crafted Precious Metal Dealer page defines the regime as excluding coins and bars, so selling refined gold and silver bars does not clearly require that registration and none is scored. County assumed-name records (Potter/Randall) and the Texas Comptroller entity search could not be checked; SOSDirect is paid.
findings.establishes: no entity registration expected; TX CPMD regime excludes bars

findings.statement: No independent footprint for 'H & H Gold Refining' / 'H&H Refining' in Amarillo or anywhere in Texas across general, Facebook, Yelp and BBB searches. The BBB directory of precious-metal dealers near Amarillo lists 12 dealers, none under this name. A business selling physical bullion bars on a POS would be expected to have a dealer shop or listing.
findings.establishes: no independent footprint for a physical-goods dealer in Amarillo

findings.statement: No website declared; the consumer Outlook contact email has no web footprint. Neither email nor business name describes payment collection. The descriptor is a personal name rather than the trading name.

Established from the account's own declared description: the merchant sells refined gold and silver bars (bullion) but is boarded under MCC 8734 (testing laboratories, non-medical). Coherent codes would be 5944 or 5094. The miscode hides a high-risk category (card-funded bullion is a known cash-out vector).
findings.establishes: MCC 8734 inconsistent with declared bullion sales

findings.statement: No presence of any age found; no scam, complaint or fraud reports under the business name or email.

evidenceNeeded: Correct MCC to 5944/5094 and route to high-risk bullion review: sales channel (in-person vs card-not-present), typical ticket size, sourcing (refinery/assay invoices).
Potter/Randall County assumed-name certificate, Texas sales-tax permit and physical premises address with photos.
Representative identity and Stripe KYC status; confirm it matches the personal-name statement descriptor.

summary: No footprint exists for 'H & H gold Refining' in Amarillo (absent from the BBB local precious-metal dealer directory and from search), the account self-declares bullion-bar sales under MCC 8734 testing labs, and it bills under a personal-name descriptor with no website. The miscode conceals a high-risk category that is a known card cash-out vector. Total 17 risk points (operating 10, businessModel 7). Correct the MCC, hold payouts pending proof of premises and sourcing, and route to high-risk review.
